from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u031/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-ad3283d9.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in result:
        markers = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        for left, right in zip(markers, markers[1:]):
            for col in range(left + 1, right):
                if row[col] == 0:
                    row[col] = 2
    return result
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
namespace = {}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), namespace)
transform = namespace['transform']
